description: Drug safety card from open sources: RxNorm normalises the name; then FDA label warnings and interactions, FDA adverse-event report counts, recent recalls, molecule facts and harm-reduction dose ranges and dangerous combinations, each source with its licence. Pass a brand or generic name, or a substance such as MDMA. Information, not medical advice. An unknown name is refused before payment. $0.005 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

name.description: drug or substance name, e.g. ibuprofen, Advil, MDMA

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.
